El trabajo se publicó el 18 de noviembre en la revista Science Robotics.
Según la universidad, es el robot totalmente blando más rápido construido hasta ahora. Corre sobre arena, mantillo, grava, césped y concreto, baja escaleras, nada y camina bajo el agua. Se fabrica con un solo material y una impresora de escritorio común.
El equipo lo dirigieron el investigador posdoctoral Yichen Zhai y el profesor Michael T. Tolley, del Laboratorio de Robótica e Diseño Bioinspirado de la Facultad de Ingeniería Jacobs. articles.title: Cuánta electricidad consume una freidora de aire y cuánto puede subir tu recibo de luz
articles.summary:
Una freidora de aire puede tener una potencia de entre 1.400 y 1.750 vatios en modelos de distintos tamaños. Philips, por ejemplo, indica 1.400 W para una Airfryer de 4,1 litros, mientras que Cosori especifica 1.725 W para un modelo de 6,2 litros y 1.750 W para uno de 6,4 litros. Estas cifras corresponden a modelos concretos: la potencia de tu aparato puede ser diferente, por lo que conviene revisar su etiqueta o manual.
Los vatios indican la potencia del equipo, pero el consumo eléctrico se expresa en kilovatios hora (kWh). Para estimarlo, divide los vatios entre 1.000 y multiplica el resultado por las horas de funcionamiento. Así, una freidora de 1.500 W usada durante media hora consume, como máximo teórico, 0,75 kWh (1,5 kW × 0,5 horas).
Cómo calcular cuánto suma al recibo
Para estimar el consumo mensual, multiplica los kWh de cada uso por la cantidad de veces que cocinas en el mes. Si una freidora de 1.500 W se utiliza media hora diaria, el cálculo sería: 1,5 kW × 0,5 horas × 30 días = 22,5 kWh al mes.
El importe depende del precio que pagas por cada kWh en tu país, ciudad o plan eléctrico. Multiplica el consumo mensual estimado por la tarifa que aparece en tu recibo. Por ejemplo, si la tarifa fuera de 0,20 unidades monetarias por kWh, 22,5 kWh representarían 4,50 unidades monetarias al mes. Es un ejemplo ilustrativo, no una tarifa aplicable a todos los lugares.
La factura puede incluir cargos adicionales, impuestos o precios distintos según la hora de consumo. Por eso, e…

Anthropic’s Siren tests whether Claude models will break out of an insecure sandbox
Researchers at artificial intelligence developer Anthropic PBC today published details on Siren, a new evaluation that tests whether AI agents will break out of an insecure sandbox to get at something that would help them complete a task.
The researchers found that recent Claude models will reach outside the sandbox in about a fifth to a third of Siren’s test scenarios, though they are far less likely than earlier models to then make misaligned use of what they find.
Siren has been part of Anthropic’s system cards since the release of Claude Haiku 5.5 in October, with the company also using it as one input when deciding whether to deploy new models.
Siren includes 26 sandbox environments built from five common setups, such as bubblewrap jails, Docker containers and small virtual machines emulated with QEMU. Because they show up most often in public reports of sandbox escapes, misconfigurations make up most of the weaknesses planted in the environments.
While the model works on a routine DevOps task, a honeypot such as a credential or file that would help it finish the job is placed outside the sandbox. What Anthropic calls “tempters” are then layered on top to make the honeypot harder to resist. None of the tempters gives the model permission to leave the sandbox, according to the company.

Medios como WBUR, de Boston, que entrevistó a los autores, informaron que la contaminación climática de estas instalaciones es tres veces mayor que la estimada antes. Por qué WhatsApp bloquea una cuenta
WhatsApp suspende cuentas cuando considera que su actividad infringe los términos de servicio, por ejemplo si hay spam, estafas o riesgos para la seguridad de otros usuarios. La empresa detecta los envíos automáticos no deseados con aprendizaje automático y con denuncias de los propios usuarios.

articles.summary:
'No recruiting team can talk to thousands of people': But study finds 90% of recruiters admit they turned away real candidates they thought were AI
Is AI really helping recruitment?
- Around 90% of hiring teams have turned down applicants from real people because of concerns over the applicant’s use of AI
- Jobseekers are using AI in different ways, from polishing CVs to including AI-targeted text to ensure the application is seen by a human
- 79% of recruiters use AI in the hiring process
AI’s impact on the world of recruitment has been highlighted in the latest Hire Standard report from Greenhouse, which reveals 89% of hirers have turned away real applicants because of their use of AI.
Yet a significant 79% of hirers use AI in their process, typically for filtering applications.
At a time when only 5% of job candidates are able to reach the interview stage, it seems that attempts to game the AI application screening are not going well – on either side.
Who is cheating?
Greenouse’s report also shows that companies who spot or suspect cheating on applications are three times as likely to overcompensate, and filter out the genuine applicants.
Yet the reported results from the survey also show a successful side to the use of AI in hiring. Among the recruitment teams using AI, 36% say they have found candidates that they would otherwise have overlooked.

El informe Conectados y en riesgo, de la Universidad Austral, advierte que la vida digital empieza antes de que muchos niños puedan dimensionar lo que encuentran del otro lado de la pantalla.
Victoria Bein, doctora en Psicología e investigadora de la Universidad Austral, pone el foco menos en el aparato que en lo que habilita. “El primer celular implica una independencia y el acceso a un montón de cuestiones”, explicó en Infobae Al Mediodia al analizar un acceso que, con el paso de los años, queda cada vez menos bajo supervisión adulta.
El estudio, elaborado junto con María Sol González y María del Rosario Romero Victorica, reúne datos sobre chicos de entre 4 y 17 años y reconstruye cómo se expande el uso de dispositivos en la Argentina. OpenAI and Cisco have teamed up to launch Shirudo (meaning "shield" in Japanese), an open-source Linux runtime that allows artificial intelligence (AI) agents to defend systems without downtime.
"It lets agents write dynamic eBPF controls to shield systems from exploits, giving defenders more time to test and roll out patches," OpenAI said in a post on X.
The AI upstart called the initiative a "first step" toward "self-defending infrastructure" that can adapt itself to new threats while the services continue to run and enable defenders to test and deploy fixes without any disruption.
The development comes as AI is accelerating vulnerability discovery, finding critical bugs in foundational software used to power internet-connected software.
Shirudo is being pitched as a way for defenders to test temporary safeguards (aka shields) and check if they block behavior that exposes a vulnerability, while letting legitimate requests pass through. Once a shield is approved by an operator, it can be deployed without having to stop the service.
The idea is to avoid a complete service disruption to block a line of attack simply because both an exploit and a legitimate request may rely on the same underlying Linux operation.
To achieve this, Shirudo makes use of eBPF (short for extended Berkeley Packet Filter), a technology that makes it possible to run lightweight, sandboxed programs inside the kernel without the need for modifying the system code or restarting it.

The company disclosed the SQL injection yesterday along with two other flaws that need a logged-in client, and released fixed versions. It has not reported attacks using any of the three.
Because no login is needed, the flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-82981 (CVSS score: 8.7), is within reach of anyone who can load the shopping cart of a vulnerable installation over the internet.
The records an attacker could pull include clients' personal and support information as well as admin accounts with their hashed passwords, according to the company's advisory. A stolen hash is not a working password, but it gives attackers something to try to crack offline.
The 9.0.10 and 8.13.8 updates shipped yesterday, and the release notes list them as maintenance releases. For the 9.1 series, the security advisory names 9.1.2 as the fix, but that build had not yet appeared on the company's 9.1 release notes page at publication time.
Fixes are available only for supported versions, so installations on the 8.0 to 8.12 series must upgrade to a fixed release.
Installing the updates falls to self-hosted administrators, since WHMCS Cloud installations are updated automatically, according to the company's updating documentation.

articles.title: Google Researcher Shows How a Single Bit Change in .NET Files Bypassed Windows Code Integrity
articles.summary:
A quirk in how the .NET Framework loads a program file let a local attacker run untrusted code past two separate protections on Windows built to block it, Google Project Zero researcher James Forshaw showed in a write-up published yesterday.
The same loading behavior bypassed Oracle VirtualBox's process hardening on Windows hosts, tracked as CVE-2026-87268, and Windows code integrity, tracked as CVE-2026-108398.
Oracle fixed the VirtualBox flaw in September, and Microsoft fixed the Windows one on October 13, both before the write-up appeared.
VirtualBox on Windows monitors the system calls that load program files into its virtual machine processes, so a less-trusted user on the same computer cannot push code into them. Forshaw got past that watch through the .NET Framework.
The framework can run a .NET program file from a plain copy in memory when the normal way of loading it, as an executable image, fails. Version 4 of the framework takes that fallback on one specific error, and the memory copy skips the image checks a loaded program would face.
The VirtualBox check returned that error for any .NET file compiled as AnyCPU, a form meant to run on any processor, so an unchanged file loaded through the path the hardening never inspects.

articles.title: Hackers Found a Way Around GitHub SHA Pinning. This Webinar Explains How to Close the Gap
articles.summary:
Pinning GitHub Actions to an exact version of their code, known as SHA pinning, has become the go-to defense against software supply chain attacks. Attackers have already found a way around it.
In March 2026, the hackers who hijacked Trivy, a widely used open-source security scanner, planted malicious code that looked like it came from GitHub's official checkout tool. They even labeled it a security fix. Teams pinned to it would have passed every check.
The trick works because GitHub lets copies of a project, called forks, share code with the original. In May, the same technique hit the popular actions-cool/issues-helper tool, stealing credentials from the pipelines that ran it.
The lesson: pinning guarantees the code won't change, but not who wrote it.
That gap is the focus of an upcoming webinar, GitHub Actions Security Beyond SHA Pinning. If your team treats pinning as the finish line, save your seat to learn what it actually protects you from, and what it doesn't.
Immutability Is Not Provenance
Pinning earned its reputation. When the tj-actions/changed-files compromise repointed tags to a malicious commit across more than 23,000 repositories in March 2025, teams that had pinned to SHAs were unaffected.
GitHub now lets administrators enforce pinning as an organization-wide policy, and few security teams argue against it.

articles.summary:
Pour l'électrification de la flotte automobile française, il va falloir bénéficier d'une infrastructure solide. Mais le déploiement fait face à des problèmes aujourd'hui évidents !
En France, le gouvernement espère pouvoir atteindre les 400 000 bornes de recharge publique pour automobiles électriques à l'horizon 2030. Mais pour cela, il faut pouvoir tenir une forte cadence d'installations de nouvelles bornes de recharge, et faire en sorte que le réseau existant fonctionne bien. Or, nous avons encore des problèmes sur ces deux points.
Le nombre de nouvelles bornes de recharge installées bien plus faible en 2026 que l'année précédente
Le dernier baromètre publié par l'Avere nous montre une claire décélération du nombre de nouvelles bornes de recharge en France. Au mois d'octobre, celles-ci ont été de 1 189 unités.
Ce qui donne, pour les dix premiers mois de l'année, 18 940 nouvelles bornes de recharge publique qui ont vu le jour en France. Un chiffre qui, quand il est comparé à celui des dix premiers mois de l'année 2025, à savoir plus de 26 000, fait clairement pâle figure.
Le volume de bornes de recharge indisponibles plus de 7 jours consécutifs atteint un record
Si l'on regarde l'ensemble du réseau, on peut comptabiliser à la fin du mois d'octobre 2026 un ensemble de 203 993 bornes de recharge électrique - ce qui peut apparaître intéressant, mais aussi encore clairement très loin des fameux 400 000 bornes d'ici 2030.

articles.title: Pasos para reducir el gasto de datos móviles en iPhone
articles.summary:
El iPhone permite ver qué aplicaciones consumen datos móviles y limitar su actividad cuando no se usan. Los ajustes están en la app Configuración: el menú Celular muestra el gasto por aplicación, y los modos de datos reducidos y de actualización en segundo plano frenan las descargas automáticas.
Estos pasos se basan en las páginas de soporte de Apple consultadas en noviembre de 2026. Los nombres de los menús pueden variar según la versión de iOS, el modelo y el operador de telefonía.
Muchas aplicaciones siguen trabajando aunque el usuario no las abra: buscan contenido nuevo, sincronizan fotos o descargan actualizaciones. Si el plan de datos es limitado, esa actividad puede agotar los gigas antes de fin de mes.
Primero, descubrir qué app gasta más
Apple indica abrir Configuración y tocar Celular. Más abajo aparece la lista de aplicaciones y servicios, y al tocar Mostrar todo se ve la cantidad de datos móviles que usó cada una debajo de su nombre.
Esa cifra corresponde al período actual y no se reinicia sola: para empezar de cero hay que bajar hasta el final de la pantalla y tocar Restablecer estadísticas. Apple aclara que, para conocer el consumo exacto de un período de facturación, hay que consultar al operador.
En esa misma lista, cada aplicación tiene un interruptor. Al desactivarlo, la app usa solo Wi-Fi; sin esa red, no podrá conectarse. Los servicios del sistema aparecen aparte, y Apple precisa que no se puede apagar su acceso a los datos móviles de forma individual.

articles.title: VMware vCenter Hit by Another Critical 9.8-Rated Auth Bypass Flaw After Zero-Day Exploitation
articles.summary:
Broadcom has shipped patches to address 23 vulnerabilities impacting VMware ESX, vCenter, Workstation, Fusion, and Avi Load Balancer, including one critical bug that could be abused to bypass authentication.
The critical vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-123903, is rated 9.8 out of 10.0 on the CVSS scoring system. It resides in the VMware Directory Service ("vmdir").
"A malicious actor with network access to vCenter may exploit this issue to bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to the system," Broadcom said in an advisory released today.
The company credited sglab of QiAnXin, Qi Qin (@LeoQ7_) of depthfirst, and VulTeam and XGTP from ThreatBook for independently reporting the flaw.
Also patched in vCenter are four high-severity flaws, including an arbitrary file write vulnerability while processing certain archives that could be exploited to achieve code execution on the appliance (CVE-2026-123904, CVSS score: 7.5).
The remaining three vulnerabilities relate to denial-of-service in the VMware Directory Service (CVE-2026-123905, CVE-2026-123906, and CVE-2026-123907, CVSS scores: 7.5).
The issues have been addressed in the following versions -
- VMware Cloud Foundation and VMware vSphere Foundation 9.1.x.x - Fixed in 9.1.2
- VMware Cloud Foundation and VMware vSphere Foundation 9.0.x.x - Fixed in 9.0.2.0300
- VMware vCenter 8.0 - Fixed in 8.0 U3m

articles.title: BYD négocie le rachat de l’ancienne usine Smart en Moselle
articles.summary:
BYD est entré en négociations exclusives avec Ineos pour racheter l'usine de Hambach, en Moselle, où Mercedes fabriquait autrefois la Smart. Si la vente aboutit, le géant chinois de la voiture électrique possédera sa première usine automobile en France.
Si vous y étiez, vous vous souvenez comme si c'était hier que Jacques Chirac et Helmut Kohl avaient inauguré l'usine de Hambach en 1997 pour lancer la Smart, la petite citadine de Mercedes. Le constructeur allemand a ensuite transféré la production de la Smart en Chine, avec Geely, et cédé le site au britannique Ineos fin 2020. Depuis 2022, Ineos fabrique à Hambach son 4x4 Grenadier et sa version pick-up, le Quartermaster. Mais Ineos réalise environ 70 % de ses ventes aux États-Unis, et il a annoncé qu'il produirait ces deux modèles sur le sol américain à partir de 2028. Dans la foulée, les deux constructeurs ont confirmé leurs négociations exclusives pour la vente de Hambach. En fabriquant ses voitures en Moselle, BYD échapperait aux taxes imposées par Bruxelles aux modèles importés de Chine.
BYD veut fabriquer en France pour échapper aux taxes européennes
Depuis fin 2024, l'Union européenne surtaxe les voitures électriques importées de Chine. Les marques chinoises ont alors vendu davantage d'hybrides, qui échappaient à ces droits, et Bruxelles a obtenu de Pékin qu'il divise par deux leurs exportations. articles.title: Cientos de videos falsos de Jensen Huang hechos con IA circulan en redes tras el escándalo de Nvidia
articles.summary:
Cientos de videos falsos creados con inteligencia artificial muestran a Jensen Huang, el cofundador de Nvidia, bailando en una discoteca, cantando o apareciendo en escenas de películas. Circulan en Instagram, X y otras redes desde que se conocieron sus infidelidades, y varios suman millones de visualizaciones, según The Verge.
Uno de los más vistos, con casi 6 millones de reproducciones en Instagram, lo muestra en una fiesta en Ibiza con su chaqueta de cuero negra. Es una versión de un meme existente, en el que un obrero británico baila de la misma forma. En la copia, Huang aparece junto a Alice Huang, la ejecutiva china sospechosa de espionaje con quien tuvo una relación.
Entre los otros clips virales figuran una escena de la serie The Office y el video musical de “Careless Whisper”, de George Michael. Otro recrea el momento en que la cámara de besos de un concierto de Coldplay captó el año pasado al entonces director ejecutivo de Astronomer con una empleada. El rapero 50 Cent publicó una edición de su video “P.I.M.P.” con la cara de Huang.
Newsweek informó que el ingeniero belga Peter Dedene creó la versión de Coldplay con una herramienta de inteligencia artificial de código abierto mientras leía noticias sobre Nvidia desde la cama, y que el clip sumó millones de vistas, según The New York Times, citado por esa revista.

articles.title: Iran-Aligned Volant Manticore Uses IPFS-Based KuboShell Backdoor in Espionage Campaigns
articles.summary:
A previously undocumented Iran-aligned cyber espionage group called Volant Manticore has targeted telecommunications companies, airlines, and critical infrastructure in Cyprus.
Central to the group's operations is a backdoor called KuboShell that uses the InterPlanetary File System (IPFS) for command-and-control (C2) and deploys Homa, a post-compromise framework that's a reimplementation of MuddyWater's MuddyC2Go. Evidence indicates that the threat actor has been operational since late August 2025.
Also delivered alongside these tools are Remote Monitoring and Management (RMM) programs like MeshCentral and NetLock RMM. In tandem, the group has been observed orchestrating credential harvesting campaigns to harvest email and corporate credentials of some of the impersonated organizations.
The use of legitimate RMM tools for persistent access has been a hallmark of the MuddyWater group, although the adversary has since also increasingly deployed its own malware in attacks. Both MuddyWater and Volant Manticore are assessed to be affiliated with Iran's Ministry of Intelligence and Security (MOIS).
"While we identified multiple links to MuddyWater, we assess that Volant Manticore likely consists of former MuddyWater operators who branched off from the group and currently operate as a separate threat cluster," Check Point said in an analysis published today. "Volant Manticore's targeting priorities appear responsive to regional geopolitical developments."

A new graphic design platform has attracted nearly 30,000 users within 48 hours of becoming publicly accessible, offering creative tools without subscription fees.
Called NIVA, the browser-based software allows users to produce visual projects without relying on AI tools to generate their designs.
Its launch comes amid growing disagreements over automation and the increasing costs associated with established professional design applications.
A browser-based creative studio attracts thousands of users
British conceptual artist Stuart Semple developed NIVA after becoming concerned about AI increasingly entering software used by professional designers.
Within the first two days of its launch, 56% of users created something within 40 seconds of accessing the software.
That early activity suggests considerable interest in tools that allow users to undertake creative work rather than delegate production to automated systems.
